names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 27 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Iuliu Veteranul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ιούλιος ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life opens «În timpul persecuției împăraților Dioclețian (284-305) și Maximian Galeriu (305-311)» and dates the decree that removed Christian soldiers from the army to after the victory over the Persians «în anul 297». The page states no year for his death; the interval recorded is the span of the two reigns it does print.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 27 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Iuliu Veteranul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιούλιος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: **saint.gr keeps him on 26 Μαΐου where doxologia.ro keeps him on 27 mai, one day apart, and the row records the day page that was read.** The identification is not in doubt: both accounts give a soldier of the Roman army at **Durostorum in Moesia**, brought before the governor **Maximus**, pressed to sacrifice, refusing, and beheaded; the folder's own life already has all four of those from the Romanian side. The Greek adds a flat year the Romanian page does not give, «καταδικάσθηκε στον δι' αποκεφαλισμού θάνατο το 302 μ.Χ., επί αυτοκράτορα Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)», and the head line repeats it; **the folder's `dates` is left as it is**, an interval «between 284 and 311» that a reader does not replace from an upgrade file, and the Greek's 302 is recorded here and in the added paragraph so that a later reader can lift it with a citation. The Greek also links him to three saints of another day — «συνδεόταν με τους αγίους Πασικράτη, Βαλεντίωνα και Ησύχιο, που μαρτύρησαν νωρίτερα (τιμούνται 24 Απριλίου)» — and the corpus keeps none of the three, so none is linked. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Cu podoaba virtuților strălucind și împodobit cu lumina muceniciei fiind, Sfinte Iuliu, strălucești mai mult decât soarele, diamantule slăvit, luminând pe cei ce-ți fac cu dragoste pomenirea cea delumină-purtătoare, de-Hristos încununatule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Iuliu Veteranul

english.text: Shining with the adornment of the virtues and arrayed in the light of martyrdom, holy Julius, thou shinest brighter than the sun, O glorious diamond, giving light to those who keep with love thy light-bearing memory, thou who art crowned by Christ.
